CONTROL_REPOSITORY.purpose: Persist SAFOR project bindings, control/value-stream/execution states, decisions, evidence, package snapshots, repository-native agent workspaces, MASTER job lifecycle and audit records.

WORK_REPOSITORY.purpose: Persist domain work artifacts such as source code, manuscripts, research outputs, designs or other factory-defined deliverables.

FACTORY_RUNTIME_CODE_REPOSITORY.purpose: Optional dedicated implementation repository for executable SAFOR runtime/adapters.

note: Domain work artifact classes are defined by the bound FACTORY package. This policy intentionally contains no software-specific source/test/config taxonomy.

selfHealingSafety.allowed: Only verified, bounded, non-destructive repairs within existing authorization.

controlRepositoryRequirement.rule: SAFOR may not initialize, select a project, bind packages or execute work unless `{selectedOwner}/safor-memory` exists and read/write access is proven.

agentWorkspaceOwnership.rule: Agent protocol writes are restricted to the agent's own state/outbox/evidence/audit workspace. Agents may not mutate registry, identity, inbox index, canonical job JSON, HUMAN job Markdown, scheduler state, dispatch waves, resource leases or MASTER job lifecycle artifacts.
agentWorkspaceOwnership.actualRightsRule: Provider-observed permissions remain authoritative; workspace ownership is a SAFOR policy boundary, not a credential or permission grant.
agentWorkspaceOwnership.discoveryRule: MASTER maintains agents/{agentId}/inbox/index.json as a non-authoritative discoverability projection. Agents read that fixed path, then verify the referenced job contract and master/jobs/{jobId}.json before claim; directory enumeration is not required.
agentWorkspaceOwnership.humanReadableResultRule: Every agent job persists both outbox/{jobId}.result.json and outbox/{jobId}.result.md. The JSON pins the Markdown blob and control-repository commit.
agentWorkspaceOwnership.gitTraceRule: Every mutating agent job must use only MASTER-declared dedicated job branches, report resulting commit SHAs and changed paths, and provide provider readback evidence. Direct default-branch mutation by an agent is forbidden.
agentWorkspaceOwnership.humanReadableJobRule: MASTER creates agents/{agentId}/inbox/{jobId}.md as a non-authoritative projection of the immutable JSON job contract. JSON pins the Markdown blob identity. Both artifacts require provider readback before the job is exposed as READY.
agentWorkspaceOwnership.jobAuthorizationRule: Repository/provider permissions declared in a job are maximum permitted scope only. Actual host/provider rights and active mandate/policy must independently allow every operation.
agentWorkspaceOwnership.returnRouteRule: Job outputContract fixes machine result, HUMAN result, evidence and audit destinations before dispatch; ad-hoc return paths are forbidden.
